description: This PHP class represents a data transfer object (DTO) for pending actions within the OrangeHRM dashboard plugin. It encapsulates an ActionSummary object and provides a method to generate a summary array if there are pending actions.

classes.name: PendingAction
classes.description: DTO class for representing pending actions in the dashboard, utilizing traits for internationalization support.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with an ActionSummary instance.

methods.name: generateActionSummary
methods.description: Generates an array summarizing the pending actions if any are present; otherwise returns null.
